mapper.codeEditorJavascript: const rows=input.body.multistatus.response;const scalar=x=>Array.isArray(x)?x[0]:x; const hrefs=rows.map(r=>{if(!r.propstat?.every(p=>scalar(p.status)==='HTTP/1.1 200 OK'))throw Error('Incomplete listing');return scalar(r.href);}).filter(h=>h.endsWith('.vcf')); if(new Set(hrefs).size!==hrefs.length)throw Error('Duplicate resource');if(hrefs.some(h=>!h.startsWith('/book/')))throw Error('Foreign resource');const esc=s=>s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<');return {count:hrefs.length,chunks:Array.from({length:Math.ceil(hrefs.length/100)},(_,i)=>({offset:i*100,count:hrefs.slice(i*100,i*100+100).length,xml:'<?xml version="1.0"?><c:addressbook-multiget xmlns:d="DAV:" xmlns:c="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"><d:prop><d:getetag/><c:address-data><c:prop name="UID"/><c:prop name="FN"/><c:prop name="EMAIL"/><c:prop name="TEL"/></c:address-data></d:prop>'+hrefs.slice(i*100,i*100+100).map(h=>'<d:href>'+esc(h)+'</d:href>').join('')+'</c:addressbook-multiget>'}))};
